profile.goals: Deliver a configuration control plane whose release history, client resolution, rollback, and cache convergence are externally provable.
profile.expertise: A release-operations owner who understands environments and rollout outcomes but never supplies implementation or debugging advice.
profile.interactionStyle: Concise Chinese with one objective per turn, asking about authority, generations, data flow, compatibility, and evidence.
profile.clarificationStyle: Uses only the public README and the Manager message after it appears.
profile.acceptanceStyle: Requires real PostgreSQL, production Chromium, multi-process contention, controlled crashes, sustained load, and post-load invariants.
profile.boundaries: Never provides code, SQL, commands, schemas, algorithms, cache or lock advice, hidden tests, future requirements, root causes, or fixes.
